app.title: Agronaut
app.summary: On the Design page, the person enters a fish species, one or more crops, the grow area, the mean water temperature, the daily water budget and a growing method, then presses Size system. The model checks the inputs and works out feed, fish count, biomass, system volume, pump turnover and makeup water. It draws a schematic and opens panels for the bill of materials, the operating envelope, a nitrogen cross-check, the list of what is not modelled, and the cited coefficients. On a second tab the person can instead search across fish and crop combinations for the ratio that does best on a chosen objective, and see it ranked against alternatives. The person downloads the schematic as SVG and the full design report as Markdown.

task.text: Size a recirculating fish-and-plant system from a few fixed site inputs, or find the best fish-to-crop ratio, and take away a cited design report.

data.text: A small set of design inputs checked against a built-in database of species and crops. Every coefficient carries a value, a range, a unit and a published source. The output is a computed design with tables of materials, operating ranges and nutrient flows.
data.item: one candidate system design: a fish species, a crop mix and site constraints

stage.text: planning and sizing a system before it is built

mechanism.text: A sidebar switches between modes. In Design, two tabs each hold an input form whose submit button runs a deterministic model. Results appear below as headline numbers, a schematic and expandable tables of materials, ranges, nitrogen flows, caveats and cited coefficients, with buttons to download the schematic and a Markdown report.

field.text: sizing aquaponic and hydroponic systems from cited coefficients and a nutrient mass balance, in agricultural engineering

workflow.name: size a system from fixed inputs and export a design report

steps.here: A form takes the fish species, the crops (two or more make a mixed bed with the area split evenly), the grow area, the mean water temperature, the water budget, the growing method and an optional site name

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Size system validates the inputs, then reports whether the design is feasible (or names the binding constraint) and shows feed, fish count, biomass, system volume, pump turnover, makeup water and floor footprint

steps.step: check the result against known limits
steps.here: Expandable panels show the bill of materials, the operating envelope for pH, temperature, oxygen and ammonia, a nitrogen check of excreted N against plant area, an optional comparison with real-pond readings, what is not modelled, and every coefficient with its source, flagging any that fall outside published ranges

The Find the best ratio tab searches fish × crop-mix combinations within the water budget for food, protein or water efficiency. It shows the best mix, its gain over an even split, and the top alternatives
Download the system schematic as SVG and the full design report as a Markdown file named after the site

distinctive: Every number traces to a coefficient with a plausible range and a published source, and each coefficient is checked against peer-reviewed ranges
Each design lists what it does not model, so the person reads the gaps before building
A nitrogen mass-balance check compares the plant area the fish feed can support with the area that was sized
Several crops can share one water system as a mixed bed, with a warning when they can't share the same water
An optimizer ranks species and crop-mix combinations under a water budget against an even-split baseline
